items.summary: Recommendation: preserve evidence_needed for fleet security and blocked status for gated-product exposure. Fleet-doctor and operations sweeps have no results, and authentication, secrets, isolation, release, dependency, monitoring, incident, and disclosure controls remain unverified. Continue read-only evidence capture only.

Security disposition: evidence_needed for fleet-wide controls; blocked for gated-product public exposure; conditional for ordinary reversible growth. Evidence: fleet-doctor has no run or results; operations deploy, uptime, and error sweeps are unavailable; authentication, access boundaries, secrets handling, runtime isolation, release controls, dependency provenance, monitoring, incident response, and disclosure readiness are unverified. TLS evidence only shows no certificates expiring within 30 days; it does not establish complete TLS posture. Compliance reports 36 pass, 17 fail, and 6 unknown and is not certification. Risk severity: high for public gated-product launch because material controls are unknown; medium for bounded reversible fleet changes that add no credentials, dependencies, permissions, data collection, or cross-site behavior. Exact decision: do not authorize public exposure, credential or permission changes, deployment, alert expansion, or external outreach; continue existing read-only security evidence capture and permit only reversible growth preserving current consent, disclosures, data handling, claims, and affiliate boundaries. Reassess when concrete evidence exists for each listed control area. No new security proposal or duplicate telemetry request is warranted this cycle.
